description: This file contains localization and cultural information for the Armenian (Armenia) culture, including day names, month names, date formats, regex patterns for parsing dates, timezone info, and date prototype extensions for formatting and manipulation, specifically for the DateJS library.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Sets the time part of the date object to midnight (00:00:00).

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time to the current time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the date object with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day of the week from its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the month index from its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a given month of a specific year.
